title: A builder may change only comments in a test file, if the owner allows it
why: Degen ledger D9: the builder-test-edit guard refuses a comment-only test edit, so a comment fix costs a test-author agent.
note: Waits on owner item builder-test-comment-edit (n 679, posted 21:55 CST Nov 12). On a: the guard allows a test-file diff whose only changes are comments, proven by the language tokenizer (rule building-scanner-respects-strings). Departs from decision builders-cannot-edit-tests. Owner 21:59 CST Nov 12 (chat with the retrospective, relayed 22:01 CST): Q4 a: allowed, comment-only diffs proven by the language parser (store entry builder-test-comments). Ready.
